'''Managan''' is a merchant born in ruined [[Malkier]]. He lives in [[Saldaea]] now.

== Appearance ==
He is lean and refused to wear the [[Hadori]]. He is growing a bit soft around the stomach.

== Activities ==
He overhears [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] conversation with [[Weilin Aldragoran]] telling him that the [[Golden Crane]] has been risen and that [[Lan Mandragoran]] rides into the [[Blight]]. Managan celebrates and will join him.

He sells everything he owns to purchase supplies for Lan's company. He catches up with Lan close to the border of [[Arafel]] and is introduced to him by [[Andere]]. Lan grudgingly accepts him into the group only if he swears not to reveal who Lan is.
